About Sandsoft:

Headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, Sandsoft is a global video game developer, publisher and investor with a focus on engaging and entertaining players worldwide.Our vision is to be the leading mobile-first games publisher & developer out the MENA region.Our international team is composed of passionate and brave game makers with vast experience in developing, publishing and leading highly successful AAA mobile, console and desktop games including FIFA, Candy Crush, Need for Speed, Angry Birds, World of Tanks and more!Through a passion for games, Sandsoft Games aims at bringing closer continents, cultures, and people.

About the Job:

We are looking for a talented and experienced Creative Director, visionary at heart and a storyteller by nature, to shape and drive our creative marketing strategy. In this pivotal role, you will oversee the creative direction for our portfolio, helping to shape the creative vision for each game in our portfolio while reaching millions of players worldwide. The ideal candidate will have a blend of leadership, strategic thinking, and deep creative expertise, with a strong experience with mobile games and performance-driven marketing. In this role, you will work closely with internal teams and external partners to align each game’s creative direction with our marketing strategy, ensuring performance focused creatives across all channels. You’ll lead a high-performing team in producing outstanding marketing assets across multiple channels, creating compelling experiences that elevate our games and drive engagement.
requirements:
What you will do:

- Lead creative vision and strategy at the portfolio level, overseeing creative direction for all games and challenging marketing guidelines, prioritization, and execution standards.

- Manage and mentor a team of creatives, inspiring high-quality and high-performing assets across UA and ASO.

- Drive portfolio-wide creative testing strategies, leveraging data to guide learnings that will direct new concepts, iterations, and high-impact creative solutions.

- Collaborate closely with product teams, UA managers, and other stakeholders to ensure strong marketing performance, aligning creative outputs with broader business and performance goals.

- Stay on top of industry trends and competitor strategies, continually enhancing our creative approach to maintain a competitive edge.

- Foster innovation by exploring new creative technologies and techniques to improve efficiency and effectiveness across teams.

- Ensure all creative outputs meet high standards of quality, visual appeal, and audience resonance.

- Make it happen: whether by engaging the broader team, jumping in yourself or collaborating with partners, you ensure that creative vision comes to life.
responsibilities:
What you will bring:

- Minimum 6 years of experience in a creative leadership role, with a proven track record in mobile game marketing and creative production.

- Strong understanding of key mobile marketing metrics, including IPM, CTR, CVR, CPI, and ROAS, with a data-driven approach to creative strategy.

- Experience in managing creative teams, with excellent leadership and mentoring skills that inspire creativity and innovation.

- Proficiency in data analysis tools, project management software, and UA dashboards to drive performance insights and execution

- Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation and storytelling skills in English.

- A strong passion for gaming and deep understanding of the gaming industry.

- Experience in cross-functional team environments, with an ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a fast-paced setting.
benefits:
- Private Medical Insurance
- Gym membership 
- Up to 45 working days of remote work

jobDescription:
About Sandsoft

We are a new, dynamic games company focused on publishing, developing & investing in high quality, core mobile Free to Play game experiences and studios across the world.
We have offices in Saudi Arabia, Spain, Finland and China.
Our seasoned team is composed of passionate game makers with vast experience in developing, publishing and leading some of the most highly successful game franchises ever released including FIFA, Candy Crush, Need for Speed, Angry Birds, World of Tanks and more. And we are backed by the resources of one of the largest, most successful and prestigious corporations in the Middle East (Ajlan & Bros Holding).
We are looking for talented individuals who share the same drive and vision to help us build and grow our Studio in Riyadh.
requirements:
What will you do:

- Assist in the development of innovative, new, action-oriented mid-core titles with your team, from vision to launch
- Take ownership of core elements within the game, driving the design and development of deep, robust game systems and mechanics for core gameplay, including combat and 3Cs
- Design & prototype end-to-end gameplay & features with satisfying and novel loops to deliver a rich Player experience
- Be hands-on with all the aspects of the game creation from a design standpoint; gameplay expectations and testing, design documentation, content design and balancing
- Analyse KPIs and Player feedback to propose adjustments to the game's vision and feature-set
- Support the team in the definition and development of tooling to assist in the game creation process
- Gathering and providing feedback, and working with design & product to filter and prioritize
- Contribute to the games direction & design choices, with an eye for building engaging and immersive Player experiences
- Work alongside Design and Product to identify exciting market opportunities
- Identify the Player’s motivations to define the games vision & core pillars
responsibilities:
What you will bring:

 -  at least 4 years experience in games production as Senior, having worked at least on 2 Free to Play titles
- Strong knowledge of game development and design, through commercial or indie projects (focusing on design decisions & rational)
- Strong skills in core gameplay design for midcore titles - Combat (systems), content (units, weapons, skills), balancing
- Relevant design & technical hard skills (Unity/Unreal, Google Sheets/Excel, Compositional Frameworks, etc.)
- A passion for games and a huge ambition for creating unique, amazing and massively successful mobile games
- A high level of emotional intelligence, interpersonal & teamwork skills
- Autonomy, strong drive to get things done, and self-organization skills
- Ability to adapt your working style depending on the current stage of the production
- A data informed mindset (make decisions based on both qualitative gut feel and quantitative data and reasoning)
- High level of written and oral communication skills in English
- A deep understanding of the mobile games’ ecosystem, competition and player motivations
- Comfortable taking risks, view failure as a learning process
- A strong sense of mobile UX design

Nice to haves:

- Understanding of design areas outside of gameplay is a big plus
- Additional game design skills (level & encounter design)
- Coding/scripting skills (Unity)
- Experience and passion for RPGs & Strategy games
- An interest in social & multiplayer games
benefits:
- Relocation Package
- Private Medical Insurance in KSA
- Annual Return Flight Allowance

jobDescription:
About Sandsoft

Headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, Sandsoft is a global video game developer, publisher and investor with a focus on engaging and entertaining players worldwide.

Through a passion for games, Sandsoft Games aims at bringing closer continents, cultures, and people.

About the role

As a DevOps & Automation Engineer at Sandsoft, you will play a critical role in supporting our game development teams by architecting, automating, and managing the infrastructure and performing essential system administration tasks that power our heavy-load, real-time gaming applications. You will design and implement robust, secure, and scalable CI/CD pipelines, oversee day-to-day operational administration, and ensure that our systems operate at peak performance even under extreme loads. Your work will directly contribute to the smooth delivery of engaging gaming experiences for millions of players worldwide.
requirements:
Key Responsibilities

- Design, implement, and maintain infrastructure-as-code (IaC) using tools like Terraform, Ansible, or similar modern alternatives.
- Develop automation scripts and tools to streamline configuration management and deployment processes.
- Create and manage GitHub pipelines to support continuous integration, testing, and deployment.
- Implement automated testing, security scans, and vulnerability assessments within the CI/CD framework.
- Manage containerized applications using Kubernetes and Docker, with a focus on multi-cloud deployments (AWS, GCP, and Azure).
- Optimize resource allocation and scalability for heavy-load gaming applications, ensuring high availability with auto-scaling, load balancing, and failover mechanisms.
- Set up and maintain observability stacks using modern tools (e.g., ELK/EFK, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Sentry).
- Integrate security best practices across the deployment lifecycle, including secret management, secure coding standards, and container security.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance with industry standards and evolving best practices.
- Work closely with development teams to support and enhance their workflows.
- Maintain comprehensive documentation of automation processes, infrastructure designs, and operational procedure
responsibilities:
Requirements

- 3+ years in DevOps, automation, or cloud engineering.
- Strong analytical-thinking and Problem Solving capabilities with a passion for innovating, optimizing and debugging processes.
- Proficiency in high-level programming languages (e.g., Python) and scripting languages (e.g., PowerShell, Bash).
- Experience with Docker and Kubernetes, including managing multi-cloud container orchestration environments.
- Experience with Terraform for designing, deploying, and managing cloud infrastructure.
- Experience in creating, managing, and securing CI/CD pipelines using platforms like GitHub or GitLab.
- Hands-on experience with major public cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), including designing architectures for high-load and latency-sensitive applications.

Preferred Qualifications

- Familiarity with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and caching mechanisms like Redis, including replication and clustering.
- Knowledge of message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ) for distributed systems.
- Understanding of secret management tools (HashiCorp Vault) and service mesh technologies (Consul, Istio).
